items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He and I were like this. He would sit here and I would sit here, and Lou and I were like this. We'd get the work, we'd go out, you know, to do one-nighters.

ctx.x: I didn't quit the band because I didn't like Lou. I just got tired of traveling.
Why did you leave Fletcher Henderson?
